title: QHSE Manager
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description: About Anton. Anton Oilfield Services Group is a globally leading independent integrated oilfield technology services company, operating across major oil and gas production regions worldwide. The business covers oilfield technical services, oilfield management services, oil and gas development operations, natural gas utilization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform collaboration. Anton Group employs approximately 7,000 staff from over 30 countries and regions. Anton’s long-term goal is to become a world-leading green energy technical services company, growing together with its clients and talent to promote high-quality development in the energy industry. About the Role. Job Title: QHSE Manager Job Location: Abu Dhabi/Middle-East Department: On Sync Energy Management Services Company - QHSE Department Job Responsibilities. Manage the overall Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) program for the project, including the HSE management system and Permit to Work (PTW) process. Develop, implement, and maintain HSE policies, procedures, and plans in compliance with applicable HSE management systems and ISO 45001/ISO 14001 standards. Administer the electronic Permit to Work (PTW) system, ensuring risk assessments, hazard identification, and mitigation measures are completed before permit approval. Coordinate HSE audits, management reviews, and corrective action implementation. Ensure compliance with Life-Saving Rules and HSE requirements for all high-risk activities. Conduct site inspections, hazard identification, behavior-based safety observations, and risk assessments for high-risk operations. Lead accident, incident, and near-miss investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Monitor, analyze, and report HSE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through regular performance dashboards. Deliver HSE inductions, toolbox talks, and specialized safety training while maintaining training records. Monitor environmental compliance, including waste management, emissions control, and pollution prevention. Manage heat stress prevention programs, including environmental monitoring, work/rest scheduling, and employee awareness training. Lead emergency response activities, including emergency drills, incident coordination, and personnel training on emergency procedures and breathing apparatus use. Qualifications Requirements. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Master's degree (M.Sc.) from a reputable university. Hold at least one internationally recognized professional HSE qualification (e.g., NEBOSH, iDipNEBOSH, CSP, ASP, Grad IOSH/CMIOSH, CIH, CRSP, GSP, QEP, ADIS, or equivalent). Hold at least one recognized HSE certification in areas such as industrial safety, construction safety, environmental management, industrial hygiene, ISO 14001/ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, NEBOSH, ASSP Global Safety Management, or equivalent. Minimum 10 years of HSE experience, including at least 5 years in the oil & gas, petrochemical, or related industrial sector. Middleeast experience is preffered.

title: EHS Officer - UAE National
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description: A Snapshot of Your Day In this role you'll take ownership of the HSE Plan across our UAE projects, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the EQS team, project management, contractors, and Siemens Energy's clients to keep operations safe, compliant, and running smoothly. How You'll Make An Impact Develop, implement, and continuously review the site's HSE Plan, ensuring it stays aligned with project realities and evolving risks throughout the project lifecycle. Deliver monthly HSE performance reporting to both the Client and Project Management, translating site data into clear insights that support informed decision-making. Act as the on-site HSE expert, advising Project Management, engineers, and subcontractors on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk mitigation strategies. Lead toolbox talks and regular HSE meetings with site representatives to reinforce safety awareness and keep HSE front-of-mind across the workforce. Conduct proactive site monitoring to identify unsafe practices, behaviors, and occupational health or welfare gaps before they escalate into incidents. Uphold QA procedures and statutory, regulatory, and EHS compliance across all site activities, while modeling Siemens' Business Conduct Guidelines and a collaborative, team-first working style. What You Bring A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, EHS or relevant field together with a NEBOSH International General Certificate or NEBOSH Construction Certificate, demonstrating a solid formal grounding in HSE principles. Fresh graduate or up to 3 years of practical, hands-on experience applying HSE practices within a live project or construction environment. Strong working knowledge of health, safety, and environmental requirements, along with how to translate them into effective on-site implementation. Familiarity with applicable legal and regulatory frameworks governing workplace safety, and the ability to apply them confidently in day-to-day operations. Demonstrated leadership capability, including the confidence to drive site-wide compliance and hold stakeholders accountable to HSE standards. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with proven ability to participate in risk evaluation, risk reduction, and continuous HSE performance improvement. About The Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. title: Shift Operator
description: A Snapshot of your day Your day involves monitoring and controlling gas turbine operations in real time through DCS systems, conducting routine equipment inspections, and ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable power generation across the Khormala Power Plant. You play a key role in minimizing downtime by responding to operational needs, adhering to strict HSE standards, and maintaining the continuous performance of critical plant equipment. How You’ll Make An Impact Monitor and control gas turbine generators, auxiliary systems, and plant equipment through DCS to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Respond to alarms, investigate system abnormalities, and take corrective or emergency actions to maintain operational continuity. Conduct routine equipment inspections, identify faults or abnormalities, and support troubleshooting and maintenance activities. Safely isolate equipment and implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures while verifying plant readiness following maintenance work. Maintain full compliance with HSE standards and environmental regulations through safety inspections, hazard identification, incident reporting, and participation in safety programs. What You Bring Technical Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Control & Instrumentation Engineering, with 3-5 years of experience in power plant operations, preferably within gas turbine or combined cycle power plants. DCS Operator Certification and a recognized Health & Safety certification such as OSHA, NEBOSH, or equivalent. Strong expertise in Distributed Control Systems (DCS), gas turbine technology, auxiliary equipment, and Balance of Plant (BOP) systems. Proven knowledge of safety procedures including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hazard identification, risk assessment, and emergency response protocols. Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis, technical documentation, shift reporting, communication, and teamwork skills.
